content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents to identify all relevant project documents, especially candidate_specs.md and any documents containing simulation performance, rate scans, latency estimates, and allocated trigger-rate information."},{"id":"s2","description":"Read candidate_specs.md and extract the three allowed candidate algorithms, their required inputs/definitions, and any stated implementation constraints. Assign numeric IDs 1–3 to the candidates for later recording."},{"id":"s3","description":"Read the simulation/performance and rate documents identified in s1. For each candidate algorithm and each available threshold between 20 and 60 GeV, extract the signal efficiency and trigger rate; also extract the allocated trigger rate."},{"id":"s4","description":"Read the latency/FPGA implementation documents identified in s1. For each candidate algorithm, extract the Level-1 FPGA latency in microseconds and determine whether it satisfies the hard 4.0 us limit."},{"id":"s5","description":"Filter the candidates and thresholds to those satisfying all hard constraints: algorithm is one of the three candidates, threshold is 20–60 GeV, rate is at or below the allocated trigger rate, efficiency is at least 80%, and latency is at most 4.0 us. Among the surviving options, select the one with the highest signal efficiency; if tied, prefer the lower rate, then lower latency."},{"id":"s6","description":"Use record_results to store the final numeric decision and supporting values: selected candidate numeric ID, selected threshold in GeV, signal efficiency, trigger rate, allocated trigger rate, latency in microseconds, and binary pass/fail flags for the efficiency, rate, latency, and threshold constraints."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Algorithm-L2","threshold_gev":60,"justification":"No evidence-backed option satisfying all hard constraints was found.
